svg.title: Rectified flow and variance-preserving schedules
svg.desc: Left, the interpolation coefficients of the two schemes. Right, the resulting standard deviation of the noisy sample, flat for one scheme and dipping for the other.
svg.text: rectified flow: a = 1 - t, b = t
variance preserving: a = cos(pi t / 2), b = sin(pi t / 2)
Both schemes are the same four functions with different values; only one keeps the input scale fixed.
